svg.title: Amiga workflow: skills and agents
svg.desc: Read downward from a saved plan through implementation and source selection. A qualifying tested tip, a reconciled single source and a combined assembly meet at the accepted sealed commit. A full English scan precedes conditional publication on local master. Links lead to skills and recovery details.
svg.text: Choose the operation and its scope. Follow the arrows for a planned change, then use the directory for other skills.
From a saved plan to local master
